description: Partial observations captured by the independent reviewer before the original 12 full example plans were accidentally overwritten during regeneration. This is not a reconstructed copy of the original plans and does not support exact before/after hashes.
method: For every saved week containing a long run, divide the largest non-hard workout with kind=easy by that week's long-run estimated km. Includes recovery and mixed-taper weeks; counts are observations, not automatically defects. Separately named medium-long roles were not distinguished in this first read.
